content: Cloudflare challenge pages carry the response header cf-mitigated: challenge (only valid value 'challenge'), set for all challenge page types. Detect via response.headers.get('cf-mitigated')==='challenge'. Challenge responses always return text/html content-type regardless of requested resource. Recommended pattern: on challenge, present a surface, wait for clearance (cf_clearance cookie), retry original request. Cloudflare docs confirm the header-based detection.
